title: A Level 21 Blacksmith Just Faced A Level 180 Knight With One Tiny Dagger . . . (highlight)
caption:
In Overgeared episode 4, a level 21 blacksmith has five minutes to save his friend, and a knight above level 180 blocks the hall. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#overgeared #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #animerewind

segments.say: A level twenty-one blacksmith faces a knight over level one-eighty, with nothing but a tiny *dagger*.
To see how it got here, go back to the dungeon, where Grid is breaking out with a girl in a cat *hood*.
The guards close in, and Grid has nothing but a cheap little *dagger*.
Mid-fight, he unlocks a new skill, and slices a blade of wind through the *guards*.
He begs Euphemina for help, and she smirks, because she does not work for *free*.
When Grid finally begs, she lifts her hands, and half the guards *vanish*.
But she holds back, because a stronger skill could bring the whole dungeon *down*.
So Grid runs to find Hu-Roy, with five minutes *left*.
He races down the corridor, and every second *counts*.
Then a knight blocks the hall. Sir Leo, the hero of Winston, far above Grid's *level*.
Grid does not run. His blacksmith's wrath kicks in, and he glows *blue*.
Grid grips his tiny dagger and *charges*.
